coord: CAPE TOWN · 3 AREAS · 1 AT A TIME

slides.headline:
Your area
*unlocks*
at 50
slides.sub: 5sFindr opens Cape Town one area at a time. Here's how.

slides.label: To unlock an area
slides.body: 50 players on the list and 3 weekly games. Then the area opens to everyone.

slides.title: Why *wait*?
slides.body: A game app with no games is useless. Opening when an area has enough players means real games from day one.

slides.title: Founding *numbers*
slides.body: Join before your area opens and you get a numbered founding spot, with founding perks free for your first year.

slides.title: Organisers *skip the queue*
slides.body: Run a weekly game? You can start now in any area. Your own group plays from day one.

slides.headline:
Move your
area *closer*
slides.body: Invite the people you play with. Every signup counts toward your area.
